comments.text: There's a scene in the film where Scout Master Ward(Edward Norton) asks: "Any questions?" and a kid puts up his hand to which he replies:"Yes, Lazy Eye". Lazy Eye then asks him what's his job and he replies teacher. I wonder if this is a joke on Tom Hanks character in Saving Private Ryan where they have a bet on what his job in the real world is, to which we find out he's a teacher. Scout Master Ward then says focus, that they have a task at hand and no time for this discussion.
